title: Receipt photos per participant, with a gallery
subtitle: GASS 2.29.0 — mockup design/mockups/scontrini.html
context:
Request (2026-10-08): from the phone, photograph the receipt (or receipts) of a participant and attach them to their consegna; from the Storico, open a gallery to see them all.

What exists: the participant card (`buildParticipantCardHTML` in `public/js/shared/consegna-common.js`, full-screen on mobile), the Storico index (`public/js/storico.js`, `storico-desktop.js`, `GET /api/storico`), data on the volume `/data/gass:/app/data` on `business` (48 GB free, data today 6.5 MB). No upload code yet, no image library, helmet CSP allows `img-src 'self' data:`. A consegna row is created only by the first `POST /api/consegna` (the "Nuova consegna" button only shows the form).

Mockup: `design/mockups/scontrini.html` (sections A mobile card, B Storico → gallery → viewer, C desktop, D alternatives). App strings stay Italian; this plan is in English because fluidplan supports en/fr only. Every UI change ships on mobile **and** desktop (project rule).

phases.title: Taking photos in the card (mobile + desktop)

glossary.definition: Hidden data inside a photo file: camera model, date, sometimes the GPS position where it was taken.
A small copy of the photo (about 320 px wide) shown in lists and grids, so the page loads fast.
A database rule: when a consegna is deleted, the rows that point to it are deleted too.
The host folder `/data/gass` mounted in the container as `/app/data`; it survives image updates. The database already lives there.
A browser drawing surface; it can redraw a photo smaller and save it again as JPEG, without any server library.
A full-screen overlay that shows one photo large, with previous/next.

pages.title: Where the photos live and what they belong to
pages.intro: The structural choices: hard to change once photos exist in production.

decisions.title: Where the image files are stored
decisions.why: Photos are 100 times bigger than all the data GASS has today (6.5 MB). Where they live decides how backups, deploys and deletions work; moving them later means a migration script on production.
decisions.proposal: JPEG files on the volume, in `/app/data/scontrini/<consegna_id>/<id>.jpg` plus `<id>_t.jpg` for the thumbnail. The database keeps only the row (who, which consegna, which person, file name).
decisions.learn_more: Files are served only through an authenticated route (`GET /api/scontrini/:id/foto` and `/thumb`), never through `express.static`, so a link copied out of GASS does not open without a session. The deploy backup (`gass.db.bak-*` via `.backup()`) covers the database only: the folder needs its own copy (see D5).

options.label: Files on the volume
pros: The database stays small and fast to back up
Easy to inspect or copy by hand
cons: Two things to back up (DB + folder)
A deleted row must also delete its files

options.label: Inside SQLite (BLOB column)
pros: Deleting a row deletes the image, nothing orphaned
cons: gass.db grows from 6.5 MB to hundreds of MB
Every deploy backup copies all photos again

tasks.title: Add the photo folder helper
tasks.do: In a new `server/services/scontrini.js`: `scontriniDir()` = `/app/data/scontrini` when `/app/data` exists, else `./data-scontrini` locally, and `SCONTRINI_DIR` env override (tests use a temp dir). Create folders on demand (`fs.mkdirSync(..., { recursive: true })`). `.gitignore` and `.dockerignore` exclude `data-scontrini/`.
acceptance: No photo is ever written inside the app folder in Docker
`git status` shows no photo after a local test

decisions.title: What a photo is attached to
decisions.why: This is the table's foreign key: it decides what deletes a photo and whether someone who only paid the quota teatro (no movimento) can have one. Changing it later means rewriting existing rows.
decisions.proposal: Table `scontrini (id, consegna_id → consegne ON DELETE CASCADE, partecipante_id → users ON DELETE CASCADE, file, larghezza, altezza, byte, created_by, created_at)`. A photo belongs to *a person in a consegna*, not to the movimento row.
decisions.learn_more: Movimenti are deleted and re-inserted by some saves, so pointing at `movimenti.id` would lose photos. Deleting a consegna (admin) must also remove the folder `scontrini/<consegna_id>/`: the CASCADE removes rows only. `deleteUser` already refuses users with movimenti; for a user with photos but no movimenti it deletes their files before the row.

options.label: Consegna + person
pros: Works before the movimento is saved
cons: A photo can exist for someone with no movimento (shown in the gallery anyway)

options.label: The movimento row
pros: Photo appears only with a real purchase
cons: Needs a saved movimento first
Lost if the movimento row is recreated

tasks.title: Create the scontrini table
tasks.do: In `server/config/database.js`, next to `uscite_cassa`: `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS scontrini (...)` as in the proposal + `idx_scontrini_consegna`. Audit columns `created_by`, `created_at` only (photos are never edited).
acceptance: A fresh DB and the production DB both get the table on start
Deleting a consegna removes its rows

tasks.title: Delete files with their consegna or user
tasks.do: `DELETE /api/consegna/:id` calls `rimuoviScontriniConsegna(id)` after the transaction commits (`fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true })`); `deleteUser` (`server/services/users.js`) deletes that user's files first.
acceptance: After deleting a consegna with 2 photos the folder no longer exists

decisions.title: Who shrinks the photo
decisions.why: A phone photo is 3–6 MB: uploading it as is on 4G at the bancarella takes long and fills the disk 15 times faster. Someone has to make it smaller and make the thumbnail.
decisions.proposal: The browser does it: draw the photo on a canvas at 1600 px on the long side, JPEG quality 0.8, plus a 320 px thumbnail; send both. The server only checks they are JPEG (first bytes `FF D8 FF`) and under 1.5 MB / 100 KB.
decisions.learn_more: Redrawing on a canvas also drops the EXIF data, GPS position included. `createImageBitmap(file, { imageOrientation: 'from-image' })` keeps portrait photos upright. iPhones convert HEIC to JPEG when a web page picks the file. The upload is JSON with base64 (≈ 33% bigger, but no multipart parser): the scontrini router gets its own `express.json({ limit: '3mb' })` mounted **before** the global 100 KB parser in `server/app.js` (body-parser skips a body already parsed). Previews use `data:` URLs, already allowed by the CSP.

options.label: In the browser (canvas)
cons: Quality depends on the phone browser
≈ 40 lines of client code

options.label: On the server (sharp)
cons: Native module to build on Alpine for amd64 + arm64
Full-size photo travels on 4G

tasks.title: Add the shared resize helper
tasks.do: New `public/js/shared/scontrini.js`: `riduciFoto(file)` → `{ foto, thumb, larghezza, altezza }` (base64 JPEG strings), with `createImageBitmap` + canvas, 1600 / 320 px, quality 0.8 / 0.7.
acceptance: A 4000×3000 photo becomes 1600×1200 under 500 KB
A portrait photo stays portrait
verify: manual: upload a phone photo in the dev server, check size in the network tab

decisions.title: How long photos are kept
decisions.why: Receipts are useful to check a conto in the following weeks; after that they only take space. At ≈ 250 MB per year the disk is not a problem for many years, so this is about tidiness, not cost.
decisions.proposal: Keep them forever, like the consegne. Deleting a consegna deletes its photos.

options.label: Forever
cons: The folder only grows

options.label: Delete after 12 months
cons: A daily cleanup job to write and test
Old disputes cannot be checked

tasks.title: Delete photos older than 12 months at startup and daily
tasks.do: `purgaScontrini(db, today)` in `server/services/scontrini.js`, called at startup and every 24 h with `setInterval`.
acceptance: A photo of a consegna 13 months old is gone after start

decisions.title: Back up the photo folder at deploy
decisions.why: The deploy routine backs up only gass.db; without this, a mistake on the volume loses the photos.
decisions.proposal: The deploy routine adds `tar czf /data/gass/scontrini.bak-<version>.tgz -C /data/gass scontrini` next to the DB backup. Documented in `docs/TECHNICAL.md`.

tasks.title: Document the photo folder in the deploy and backup notes
acceptance: TECHNICAL.md names the folder and the backup command

decisions.title: When the photo is uploaded
decisions.why: At the bancarella people are in a hurry: a photo lost because the card was closed without Salva means asking the person again, or never. But today the consegna row exists only after the first Salva of the day, and a photo needs it.
decisions.proposal: Upload right after the shot, with a "carico…" bar on the thumbnail. If the consegna of that date does not exist yet, the upload creates it (same row the first Salva would create, trovato = previous lasciato).
decisions.learn_more: Creating the consegna is moved from `POST /api/consegna` into `ensureConsegna(db, data, audit)` (new, `server/services/consegne.js`), used by both routes, so the two paths cannot drift. An empty consegna created this way is like one after "Nuova consegna" + a note save: "Annulla consegna" (admin) deletes it, photos included.

options.label: Immediately, creating the consegna if needed
pros: Works for the first person of the day
cons: Consegna creation moves into a shared service (refactor of `POST /api/consegna`)

options.label: Immediately, but only once the consegna exists
cons: First person of the day: button disabled with "Salva prima" until a Salva

options.label: Queued, uploaded by Salva
cons: Photos lost if the card is closed
Salva gets slow on 4G with 3 photos

tasks.title: Add the scontrini API
tasks.do:
New `server/routes/scontrini.js`, mounted at `/api/scontrini` with `requireAuth` and its own `express.json({ limit: '3mb' })` before the global parser:

```
GET    /api/scontrini?data=yyyy-mm-dd   list of the consegna: id, partecipante_id, nome, created_by name, created_at, larghezza, altezza
POST   /api/scontrini                   { data, partecipanteId, foto, thumb } → { id, consegnaId }
GET    /api/scontrini/:id/foto          image/jpeg, Cache-Control: private, max-age=604800
GET    /api/scontrini/:id/thumb         same, thumbnail
DELETE /api/scontrini/:id               rules of D8
```

POST checks JPEG magic bytes, sizes (1.5 MB / 100 KB), that the user exists and the D9 limit; writes files first, then the row; on a DB error removes the files.
acceptance: Unauthenticated calls get 401
A PNG or a 2 MB body gets 400/413
GET foto of a missing id gets 404

decisions.title: Camera or phone gallery
decisions.why: The HTML attribute `capture` decides whether the button opens the camera directly. With it, Android does not allow choosing an existing photo: a receipt photographed earlier cannot be attached.
decisions.proposal: `<input type="file" accept="image/*" multiple>` without `capture`: the phone asks "Fotocamera / Galleria", several photos can be picked at once. Button label "Fotografa".

options.label: Phone asks camera or gallery
cons: One extra tap to reach the camera

options.label: Straight to the camera (`capture="environment"`)
cons: No gallery on Android
One photo per tap

decisions.title: Who can add and remove photos
decisions.why: Any turnista fills the consegna today; but a closed consegna is locked so the conti cannot change after the report is sent.
decisions.proposal: Any logged-in user adds photos while the consegna is open. Removing: whoever took the photo, or an admin, and only while open. Closed consegna: photos visible, nothing added or removed (an admin reopens it, as for the conti).

options.label: Locked with the consegna
pros: The report matches what is stored
cons: A receipt found the day after needs an admin to reopen

options.label: Adding always allowed, removing only while open
pros: A late receipt can be added by anyone
cons: Exception to the closed-consegna rule to explain in the manual

tasks.title: Enforce add/remove rights on the server
tasks.do: In `server/routes/scontrini.js`: POST and DELETE return 403 "Consegna chiusa" when `chiusa = 1` (per the chosen option: {{choice.label}}); DELETE also 403 unless `created_by = session user` or admin.
acceptance: A non-admin cannot delete someone else's photo
Closed consegna refuses as chosen

decisions.title: Maximum photos per person per consegna
decisions.why: Stops a stuck finger or a wrong pick of 40 gallery photos from filling the folder.
decisions.proposal: At most 6 photos per person in one consegna; the 7th gets "Massimo 6 foto".

tasks.title: Limit to {{value}} photos per person per consegna
tasks.do: Constant `MAX_FOTO_PERSONA = {{value}}` in `server/services/scontrini.js`, checked in POST (400 with message) and used by the card to hide the tile.
acceptance: Upload number {{value}} + 1 is refused

decisions.title: Who can see the photos
decisions.why: Receipts carry names and what each person bought. The conti are already visible to every logged-in user on the Consegna page, so the photos add little; but once in the gallery, restricting them later means people already saw them.
decisions.proposal: Every logged-in user, like the conti on the Consegna page. Never public: files only through the authenticated route.

options.label: All logged-in users

cons: Everyone sees what others bought

options.label: Admins, the uploader and the person in the photo

decisions.title: How a photo opens large
decisions.why: Receipts are read, not just glanced at: the person must be able to zoom and go to the next one quickly.

options.label: Own lightbox
pros: Looks like the rest of GASS
cons: ≈ 80 lines JS + CSS

options.label: Open the image in a new tab
cons: Back and forth for every photo
No name or author shown
